scene.speaker: nico
scene.bubble: The elephant is SO big and the monkey is SO funny! Zoo day is the best day!
scene.intro: Zoo day is the best day! Nico and Astrid stop in front of the elephant: it is SO big! Then the monkey, small and funny, jumps from tree to tree. The giraffe is very tall, the hippo is very fat, and the snake is long and quiet. The lion can roar, the monkey can climb, and the tiger can run. What can the animals do? Come with them and find out!

data.voice_note: Voces: Nico y Astrid (en el zoo).
data.script: Nico: The elephant is eating! Its nose is like a big arm. … Astrid: The giraffe's neck is longer than a door! … Nico: Look, four monkeys! They are jumping from tree to tree. … Astrid: The lion is sleeping. Shhh! … Nico: The hippo is in the water. Only its eyes are out! … Astrid: My favourite is the bear. It's brown and very big. … Nico: And Pip says hello to the zoo birds. New friends!
